events.label: Collision
events.summary: Mark Jansen is waiting at a red light in Eindhoven when Sanne de Vries hits the rear of his car. Both drivers sign a European accident statement.

events.label: Claim submitted
events.summary: Mark submits a claim through the online portal, with the accident statement and six photos.

events.label: Claim registered
events.summary: Lotte Verbeek registers claim CLM-10045, confirms the other driver is liable and appoints a damage expert.

events.label: Damage inspection
events.summary: Pieter Kroon inspects the car and estimates the repair at €3,240.00 including VAT.

events.label: Claim approved
events.summary: Aurelis approves the claim in full and will recover the costs from Noordhaven Verzekeringen.

events.label: Payment
events.summary: €3,240.00 is paid to Mark Jansen. No separate document; recorded in the claim metadata.
